user_intent: 如果 人在家 那么 增加 亮度
期望 温度 处于 27 ℃ 到 31 ℃
二氧化碳浓度 应 低于 6%
如果发生火灾，那么开始报警
如果发生火灾，那么打开逃生通道
人离开时，关闭所有影音、照明、环境控制及厨电类电器
standard_taps: IF aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == true THEN turn_light_up() philips_zhiyi_light
IF qingping_air_monitor.reading_temperature() > 31 AND aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == true THEN set_mode_to_cool() smart_inverter_air_conditioner
IF qingping_air_monitor.reading_temperature() < 27 AND aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == true THEN set_mode_to_heat() smart_inverter_air_conditioner
IF mijia_CO2_ultra_sensor.get_CO2_concentration() > 6 AND aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == true THEN turn_on() xiaomi_air_purifier
IF mijia_CO2_ultra_sensor.get_CO2_concentration() > 6 AND aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == true THEN turn_on() mijia_air_purifier
IF generic_hood_version_1.reading() > 0.13 AND aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == true THEN power_on() generic_hood_version_1
IF LG_fire_detector.is_fire() == true THEN beep() LG_fire_detector
IF LG_fire_detector.is_fire() == true THEN open_door() Blade_Star_smart_door
IF aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == false THEN turn_light_off() philips_zhiyi_light
IF aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == false THEN turn_off() smart_inverter_air_conditioner
IF aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == false THEN turn_off() mijia_air_purifier
IF aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == false THEN power_off() generic_hood_version_1
IF aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == false THEN turn_off() xiaomi_air_purifier
